design: Same 40 training contexts and ranks 4/8/16/32 for Euclidean PCA versus response-weighted context projection in the identical 39-dimensional training span. Metric averages squared bilinear responses over unit normalized displacements from the 40 training prompts at +1/16. No test outputs or contexts used in fitting.
metrics: KL(exact perturbed distribution || approximate perturbed distribution)
KL ratio to zero MLP response baseline
scope: Response-weighted metric uses the training-direction cross-product with training contexts, not output KL. Retrospective split on previously inspected prompts; withheld from fitting, not prospective fresh evidence. Only local context modulation compressed, not full MLP or downstream circuit. PCA optimizes context reconstruction, not response or KL.
